```{r}
#| eval: true
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-cap: Simulated random walk.
# Packages
library(ggplot2)

# Data
data <- data.frame(
  x = seq(1, 200),
  y = cumsum(rnorm(200))
)

# Plot
ggplot2::ggplot(data = data, ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::xlab(label = "Time") +
  ggplot2::ylab(label = "Value")
```
